hadith:
Pilgrims Prevented from Completing the Pilgrimage - Narrated Ka'b bin 'Ujra (ra):

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him (i.e. Ka'b) while the lice were falling on his face.
message: Reflect upon the boundless power of Allah as described in these texts. Just as He can restore even our fingertips, remember that nothing is beyond His capabilities. Let this understanding bring comfort and strengthen your faith during challenging times.
name:
Al Qaadir - الْقَادِرُ - The Powerful

The name Al Qaadir is derived from the Arabic root 'q-d-r', which denotes strength and capability. This name reflects the belief that Allah has complete control over the universe and is capable of exercising His will in all matters. It emphasizes the concept of divine power and authority in Islamic theology.
verse:
Al-Qiyamah - The Resurrection - 75:3-4

Do people think We cannot reassemble their bones?

Yes ˹indeed˺! We are ˹most˺ capable of restoring ˹even˺ their very fingertips.
